column1: # The edition's stereo integrations: one row per pack (docs: the stereo-integrations skill, "One list").
# Columns: program, pack, kind, notes (tab separated).
#   program  the Debian package of the program the pack serves (what the pack Enhances; the AppCenter installs both)
#   pack     the edition's package, sparky-stereo-<program or thing>
#   kind     data    inert files, no Depends on the program: joins sparky-stereo-integrations, which sparky-stereo-desktop
#                    depends on, so every installation carries it and a program installed later finds it in place
#            native  links against the program: Recommended by every role task whose roles.tsv lists the program, and
#                    installed with it by the AppCenter; it leaves with the program (it Depends on it)
# make-meta.py reads this file; make-appcenter-entries.py writes the AppCenter's install sets from it.
